verdict.rationale: E2B is API-first: its SDK covers the whole sandbox lifecycle, including create, run code, commands, file read/write/list, timeout changes, kill, pause/resume, metrics, network controls, templates and lifecycle webhooks. An official CLI with env-var auth adds listing, shutdown, snapshots and project selection. No evidence shows any core capability that exists only in a UI. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement; evidence that dashboard functions (API keys, team/billing management) are programmatic; a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404).
